name: Info box
summary: The settings callout in four tones (information / success / warning / error), optionally dismissible — a thin wrapper that draws the DS Alert.
highlights: Settings callout drawn by the DS Alert
Four tones: information, success, warning, error
lead: ONE custom element — <aha-info-box> — the settings-panel callout, composed from the DS <aha-alert>. Its settings API maps onto the Alert: `variant` information / success / warning / error → the Alert `type` (info / success / warning / error), `icon` → the Alert `icon`, `dismissible` → the Alert `closable`. So it has the Alert's look (grey #F3F3F3 surface, no border, #4A4A4A status glyph), its roles (role=alert for warning and error, role=status otherwise) and its leave animation. Dismissing hides the info box (the same nodes stay in place, so un-hiding shows it again) and emits `dismiss`; the host owns any persisted "don't show again" state. New code can use <aha-alert> directly.
codeNote: A thin wrapper over <aha-alert>: same element in React and Vue. React (< 19) via a thin ref wrapper; Vue binds the custom element natively. Defined once in @ahaslides-product/design.

spec.label: Box
spec.value: the Alert: padding 10 14 · radius 8 · no border · #F3F3F3 fill (gray-25) for every tone

spec.label: Glyph
spec.value: the Alert status glyph, 16px #4A4A4A: system-info · system-check-circle · system-warning-circle · system-x-circle; `icon` overrides it

spec.label: Dismiss
spec.value: optional shared ✕ (the Alert closable: tertiary icon-only <aha-button>, size xs) on the first line; fades out, then the box is hidden and emits `dismiss`

spec.label: Link
spec.value: a plain `<a href>` written straight in the message is an inline text link in the Alert's standard style (message size, weight 400, the DS text-link: Vivid Pink #E70E68, no underline at rest, underline on hover and focus, the Button focus ring; the 4.06:1 on grey and 4.16:1 on the branding fill are the recorded exception, colour rule 6.7); never an <aha-button> inside the sentence

props.name: variant
props.desc: The tone — maps to the Alert type (information → info), which sets the glyph and role

props.name: icon
props.desc: Override the tone's default glyph with a named DS icon (passed to the Alert icon)

props.name: dismissible
props.desc: Show the ✕ dismiss control (the Alert closable)

props.name: dismiss
props.desc: Composed event after the box fades out and is hidden

whenToUse.when: a settings-panel callout explaining a state or a consequence in place (same as Alert, with the settings API)
a one-line must-see consequence attached to a single setting (≤90 chars) — not a box
secondary what/why/how elaboration on a ? glyph

opinion.note: Drawn by the DS Alert; reach for <aha-alert> directly in new code. Keep callouts rare: most explanation is a ? tooltip or nothing (SETTINGS-28). Use error/warning for a consequence, not decoration.
opinion.dsv3: COVERED — the settings-lab InfoBox control mapped onto the DS Alert (<aha-alert>), which owns the surface, glyphs, roles and dismiss; the info box keeps the settings API (variant, icon, dismissible, dismiss).

snippets.label: HTML
snippets.note: The native form — a web component in an HTML file renders on open, no build step.

selfCheck.label: composed from <aha-alert>; the four tones map to Alert types
glyph by name via the Alert (no inline svg); role from the Alert
dismiss fades out on the Alert's persistent node, then hides the box and emits dismiss

conformance.$about: Measured by qa.mjs against the RENDERED UI (getComputedStyle via headless CDP), on the <aha-alert> the info box draws.
